content: There aren't enough credits for the selected storage amount. Contact your Payer (<1>{{payerContact}}</1>) to top up the wallet, or select a smaller amount.

comment.text: Error text or hint in the additional storage panel or buy plan footer appearing when credits are insufficient for the selected storage amount. The `<1>` tag wraps the `{{payerContact}}` variable, which represents the payer's contact info (name or email), and formats it as a link.
